notes.title: 25 November release of the game
notes.notes:
A lot of work has been done, and the game has become bigger and more RPG.
The game is leaving early access. And it's time to announce the release date. The game will be released on November 25th.

The game got a story.  
Were added: 
Story quests.
New heroes, 
More abilities.
New dungeon inhabitants
New NPC. 
More dialogues and events appeared.
etc.

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
New game patch. 
Patch 1.4.
-Variable battlefield. Battlefield not only 3*3 cells now. Variable shape from 2*2 to 4*4 cells.
-Blood Mage. New hero with his abilities.
-Were fixed small bugs and done small improvements.
